dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: A new school year begins.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: Another year... I hope it isn't as strange as last time.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Good morning! There's a mystery waiting for us today.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: Morning. Let's make this year better than the last.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: You stay silent. The hallway hums with early chatter.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: ...Fine. Let's just go. There's no time to waste.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: I heard there is a hidden festival plan somewhere in the school. We should look into it after classes.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Your first day of classes is about to begin.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: A crisp poster flutters on the bulletin board. It mentions an old festival that vanished years ago.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Maybe the rumor is more than just a rumor.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Oh... I didn't expect anyone else to be here.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: I was looking for a book about the old school festival. They say the history section hides the best secrets.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Thank you. I found a folded note between the pages. It mentions a secret meeting place.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: You hold the note and feel the excitement of a mystery unfolding.

dialogue.speaker: Penny
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll let you read in peace. If you want to join, I'll be at the study table.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The library's silence feels charged with something waiting to be discovered.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: Welcome! We were waiting for you. The club is planning a special event this year.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: If you join us, you can help design the invitation for the school festival.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: It is a celebration for all the clubs, but some old traditions were lost. We want to bring them back.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.text: No pressure. If you want to help later, the door is always open.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The wind is peaceful today, and the city stretches out beneath the rooftop.

dialogue.speaker: Kisetsu
dialogue.text: There's a rumor that the school once hid a secret garden up here.

dialogue.speaker: Moe
dialogue.text: If it's true, maybe the note in the library and the festival plans are connected.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The first day comes to an end. You have a new clue, a new choice, and a rumor that will not leave your mind.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, the search for the hidden festival begins in earnest.
